The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular City Council meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m.
Typically, adjourned City Council meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30
a.m. Design Review Committee meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of every
month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at
(626) 300­0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to offer public comment from home:
  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment.
  Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time, and previously
  distributed public comment will be noted. Any comments received after 3:00 p.m. will
  be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the meeting.
  2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in­person comments.

POSTING OF AGENDA

The special meeting agenda is posted 24 hours prior to each special meeting at the following
locations: City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive,
and the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The special meeting agenda is also
posted on the City’s website: http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENT

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council and
Design Review Committee by completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk
prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the City Council and Design Review
Committee on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the City Council and
Design Review Committee may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting
agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on
duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.
